summary: Backend regression + RevenueCat rc-sync smoke test. 11/11 pytest tests passed against the public preview URL. POST /api/subscription/rc-sync is correctly bearer-gated (401 unauthenticated), returns {ok:true, tier:'premium', provider:'revenuecat', expiresAt:...} for both premium_monthly (~30d) and premium_yearly (~365d), inserts a payments row with provider=revenuecat / method=apple_iap / status=success / note=client_hint_pending_webhook, and updates users.tier=premium + subscriptionExpiresAt + currentPlan + provider. GET /auth/me reflects tier=premium after sync. After rc-sync, /api/live/status now returns videoId/watchUrl/embedUrl and requiresSubscription=false for the authenticated premium user, while the same endpoint without auth still strips those fields (requiresSubscription=true). GET /api/shows/{id} returns locked=false + unlockedFor='premium' for the synced user. Regression: OTP flow (250794230137 / 123456) works; /api/radio/now-playing still returns streamUrlHttps=https://stream.bbkigali.com/stream/1/. Verified rows directly in MongoDB payments collection.

minor.issue: Review request expected basic_monthly → 400. Actual: because RcSyncIn uses Literal['premium_monthly','premium_yearly'], Pydantic returns 422 for basic_monthly (never reaches the manual `if not plan: raise HTTPException(400)` branch). This is arguably CORRECT/stronger validation. The dead 400 branch in server.py:1616-1618 is unreachable and could be removed for clarity. Test accepts both 400 and 422.

action_items: (Optional cleanup) In /app/backend/server.py:1616-1618, the `plan = PLAN_CATALOG.get(body.plan); if not plan: raise HTTPException(400, 'Invalid plan')` branch is dead code because RcSyncIn.plan is a Literal — Pydantic rejects anything else with 422 before this function runs. Safe to delete or replace with a direct `plan = PLAN_CATALOG[body.plan]` lookup.

(Optional) Review request mentions `isLocked` for /api/shows/{id}, but backend actually uses `locked` — either alias the field for iOS clients or update the docstring. Not a bug; matches existing behaviour tested in previous iterations.
critical_code_review_comments: rc_sync endpoint is well-scoped: no PII leakage, uses uuid for payment id, stamps createdAt in UTC ISO, and mirrors PLAN_CATALOG for consistency with other billing paths.

Note: rc_sync unconditionally trusts the client. This is called out in the docstring ('client hint' + 'ALWAYS reconcile against RevenueCat's authoritative state via the webhook'). Ensure the RevenueCat S2S webhook path is implemented before enabling ARR reporting — currently the code says 'pending_webhook' but no webhook handler is grep-able for provider='revenuecat' (only client sync). Follow-up for future iteration.
server.py is 4128 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (auth, radio, billing, live, admin) in a dedicated refactor.

Post-test the admin user is left as tier=premium with subscriptionExpiresAt ≈ +30d (last successful monthly sync). This does not affect production because MONGO_URL points to the local dev cluster.
